chapterInfo.content:
16
Ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi
(Marko 8.11-21)
1 # Mat 12.38 Na Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no ba bɛsɔɔ no hwɛe, srɛɛ no sɛ ɔnkyerɛ wɔn ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi. 2#Luk 12.54-56 Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Ɛduru anwummerɛ a, mose: Ewiem bɛte ɛfiri sɛ ɔsoro abere. 3#Mat 11.4-5 Na anɔpa mose: Ahum bɛtu nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsoro abere na ayɛ kusuu. Monim ɔsoro ani nsɛm mu kyerɛ, na mmerɛ no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ deɛ, montumi nkyerɛ mu. 4#Mat 12.39-40 Nnɛ mma abɔnefoɔ ne awaresɛefoɔ hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na wɔremma wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ biara, gye Yona nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no. Na ɔgyaa wɔn hɔ kɔeɛ.
Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ mmɔreka
5Na asuafoɔ no duruu asuogya nohoa no, na wɔn werɛ afiri sɛ wɔfa paanoo. 6#Luk 12.1 Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ na monhwɛ mo ho yie Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ mmɔreka ho! 7Na wɔdwendwenee wɔn mu kekaa sɛ: Yɛamfa paanoo no ntira. 8#Mat 6.30 Na Yesu hunuiɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: O nnipa a mo gyidie sua! Adɛn na moredwendwene mo mu sɛ moamfa paanoo ntira? 9#Mat 14.17-21 Monnya nhunui, na monkae nnipa mpemnum paanoo nnum no ne nkɛntɛn dodoɔ a monyaeɛ? 10#Mat 15.34-38 Anaasɛ nnipa mpemnan paanoo nson ne nkɛntɛn bebree a monyaeɛ? 11Ɛdeɛn nti na monhunu sɛ ɛnyɛ paanoo ho asɛm na mereka mekyerɛ mo? Monhwɛ mo ho yie Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ mmɔreka ho! 12Ɛnna wɔhunuu sɛ wanka sɛ wɔnhwɛ wɔn ho yie paanoo mmɔreka ho, na mmom Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
Petro kyerɛ nipa ko a Yesu yɛ
(Marko 8.27-30; Luka 9.18-21)
13Na Yesu duruu Kaesarea Filipi fam no, ɔbisaa n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nnipa se Onipa Ba no ne hwan? 14#Mat 14.2; 17.10 Na wɔse: Ebinom se: Yohane suboni no. Ebinom se: Elia. Na ebinom nso se: Yeremia anaa adiyifoɔ no mu baako. 15Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Na mo nso, mose mene hwan? 16#Yoh 6.69 Na Simon Petro buaa sɛ: Wone Kristo no, Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no ba! 17#Gal 1.15-16 Ɛnna Yesu bua see no sɛ: Nhyira ne wo, Yona ba Simon, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔhonam ne mogya na ɛyi kyerɛɛ woɔ, na m’agya a ɔwɔ soro no. 18#Yoh 1.43; Efe 2.20 Na me nso mese wo sɛ: Wone Petro, na ɔbotan yi so na mede m’asafo bɛsie, na Asamando apono remmu mfa so. 19#Mat 18.18 Na mede ɔsoro ahennie nsafoa bɛma wo, na biribiara a wobɛkyekyere asase soɔ no, na wɔakyekyere no soro, na biribiara a wobɛsane no asase soɔ no, na wɔasane no soro. 20#Mat 17.9 Ɛnna ɔhyɛɛ asuafoɔ no ketee sɛ wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara sɛ ɔno ne Kristo no.
Yesu wuo ne ne wusɔreɛ ho nkɔmhyɛ
(Marko 8.31—9.1; Luka 9.22-27)
21 # Mat 12.40; 20.18; Yoh 2.19 Na ɛfiri saa berɛ no na Yesu Kristo fitii aseɛ kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem na ɔkɔhunu amane pii mpanimfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no nsam, na wɔakum no, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no wanyane. 22Ɛnna Petro de no kɔɔ nkyɛn, na ɔfitii aseɛ twii n’anim sɛ: Ɛmpare wo, Awurade, yei remma wo so da! 23Na ɔdanee ne ho see Petro sɛ: Firi me so, Satan! Woyɛ suntidua ma me, ɛfiri sɛ wonnwene Nyankopɔn deɛ, na mmom nnipa deɛ na wodwene.
Ahopakyire
24 # Mat 10.38-39 Ɛnna Yesu see n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔdi m’akyire a, ma no mpa ne ho akyi, na ɔmma n’asɛnnua so, na ɔnni m’akyi. 25Na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔgye ne kra nkwa no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa; na obiara a me nti ne kra bɛyera no deɛ, ne nsa bɛka. 26Na sɛ onipa nya wiase nyinaa na ɔhwere ne kra a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔbɛnya? Anaasɛ, ɛdeɛn na onipa bɛma de asesa ne kra? 27#Rom 2.6 Na Onipa Ba no de n’agya animuonyam ne n’abɔfoɔ na ɛbɛba; ɛno na ɔbɛtua onipa biara ka sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ. 28#Mat 10.23 Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Nnipa binom gyina ha a wɔrenka owuo nhwɛ kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔreba n’ahennie mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no ba bɛsɔɔ no hwɛe, srɛɛ no sɛ ɔnkyerɛ wɔn ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi. Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Ɛduru anwummerɛ a, mose: Ewiem bɛte ɛfiri sɛ ɔsoro abere. Na anɔpa mose: Ahum bɛtu nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsoro abere na ayɛ kusuu. Monim ɔsoro ani nsɛm mu kyerɛ, na mmerɛ no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ deɛ, montumi nkyerɛ mu. Nnɛ mma abɔnefoɔ ne awaresɛefoɔ hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na wɔremma wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ biara, gye Yona nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no. Na ɔgyaa wɔn hɔ kɔeɛ.

Na asuafoɔ no duruu asuogya nohoa no, na wɔn werɛ afiri sɛ wɔfa paanoo. Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ na monhwɛ mo ho yie Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ mmɔreka ho! Na wɔdwendwenee wɔn mu kekaa sɛ: Yɛamfa paanoo no ntira. Na Yesu hunuiɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: O nnipa a mo gyidie sua! Adɛn na moredwendwene mo mu sɛ moamfa paanoo ntira? Monnya nhunui, na monkae nnipa mpemnum paanoo nnum no ne nkɛntɛn dodoɔ a monyaeɛ? Anaasɛ nnipa mpemnan paanoo nson ne nkɛntɛn bebree a monyaeɛ? Ɛdeɛn nti na monhunu sɛ ɛnyɛ paanoo ho asɛm na mereka mekyerɛ mo? Monhwɛ mo ho yie Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ mmɔreka ho! Ɛnna wɔhunuu sɛ wanka sɛ wɔnhwɛ wɔn ho yie paanoo mmɔreka ho, na mmom Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.


Na Yesu duruu Kaesarea Filipi fam no, ɔbisaa n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nnipa se Onipa Ba no ne hwan? Na wɔse: Ebinom se: Yohane suboni no. Ebinom se: Elia. Na ebinom nso se: Yeremia anaa adiyifoɔ no mu baako. Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Na mo nso, mose mene hwan? Na Simon Petro buaa sɛ: Wone Kristo no, Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no ba! Ɛnna Yesu bua see no sɛ: Nhyira ne wo, Yona ba Simon, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔhonam ne mogya na ɛyi kyerɛɛ woɔ, na m’agya a ɔwɔ soro no. Na me nso mese wo sɛ: Wone Petro, na ɔbotan yi so na mede m’asafo bɛsie, na Asamando apono remmu mfa so. Na mede ɔsoro ahennie nsafoa bɛma wo, na biribiara a wobɛkyekyere asase soɔ no, na wɔakyekyere no soro, na biribiara a wobɛsane no asase soɔ no, na wɔasane no soro. Ɛnna ɔhyɛɛ asuafoɔ no ketee sɛ wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara sɛ ɔno ne Kristo no.


Na ɛfiri saa berɛ no na Yesu Kristo fitii aseɛ kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem na ɔkɔhunu amane pii mpanimfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no nsam, na wɔakum no, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no wanyane. Ɛnna Petro de no kɔɔ nkyɛn, na ɔfitii aseɛ twii n’anim sɛ: Ɛmpare wo, Awurade, yei remma wo so da! Na ɔdanee ne ho see Petro sɛ: Firi me so, Satan! Woyɛ suntidua ma me, ɛfiri sɛ wonnwene Nyankopɔn deɛ, na mmom nnipa deɛ na wodwene.

Ɛnna Yesu see n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔdi m’akyire a, ma no mpa ne ho akyi, na ɔmma n’asɛnnua so, na ɔnni m’akyi. Na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔgye ne kra nkwa no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa; na obiara a me nti ne kra bɛyera no deɛ, ne nsa bɛka. Na sɛ onipa nya wiase nyinaa na ɔhwere ne kra a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔbɛnya? Anaasɛ, ɛdeɛn na onipa bɛma de asesa ne kra? Na Onipa Ba no de n’agya animuonyam ne n’abɔfoɔ na ɛbɛba; ɛno na ɔbɛtua onipa biara ka sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ. Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Nnipa binom gyina ha a wɔrenka owuo nhwɛ kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔreba n’ahennie mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
